about: Invented. An English recipe stays in English; 'to taste' is not an amount; a range with an en dash and a can size stay as written. A quick lunch salad with feta: the salads category since 2026-11-01 (a salad with cheese is a salad; before, a light meal or none).

expect.title: Chickpea & Feta Lunch Salad

items: 1 (15 oz) can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
A handful of fresh parsley, chopped

preparation: Toss everything together in a large bowl.
Season to taste and serve right away, or chill for up to 2 hours.
